meta.title: Tool result slimmer
meta.description: Periodically removes provably-safe stale tool results (duplicate copies, failed attempts superseded by later successes, information-free output) under the conservative policy: drops only, never rewrites content, and keeps anything it cannot prove safe. The planner calls the current model directly, creates no subagent, and does not change the main agent's tool list. The chat transcript keeps the original tool cards and adds one row reporting what was slimmed. Sampling thresholds, the slimming policy, and the model override are editable in the native Plugins panel and apply live.
